slides.texte_overlay:
how to steal Brad Pitt's
charisma without looking
like him
Smile with your eyes, not just your mouth. A slow, relaxed smile looks warm and confident. A quick forced grin looks like you're trying too hard.
Laugh at yourself easily. Charismatic people don't take every small mistake seriously. A light reaction to your own slip-ups makes people relax around you.
Wear simple clothes that fit perfectly. A plain t-shirt, good jeans, clean boots. Effortless style comes from fit and confidence, not from logos.
Give people your full attention. Turn your body toward them, keep your phone away, ask a second question. Feeling truly seen is magnetic.
Have real stories to tell. I do five minutes a day of history, art or science, and a man with interesting things to share never needs to show off.
slides.texte_sophia: I do five minutes a day on a micro-learning app like the Sophia app. History, art, science. A man with interesting things to share never needs to show off.

slides.texte_overlay: Stay relaxed under attention. When people look at you, don't fidget or rush. Slow, calm movements make you look at ease anywhere.
Be kind to everyone, especially when no one is watching. Charisma isn't a trick for the room. It's how you treat people when it doesn't matter.
